name: Bugbear
body:
Bugbears are hulking goblinoids, much larger than their goblin and hobgoblin cousins, yet surprisingly stealthy for their size. They are bullies at heart, delighting in spreading fear and misery.

Physical

Bugbears are covered from head to toe in coarse hair, which is typically yellow, red, brown, or black. They have red eyes and mouths full of crooked fags. They would stand about 7 feet tall if they ever stood upright, but they walk with a hunched posture, like an ape.

Despite their muscular build and awkward gait, they are amazingly graceful. However, most are also extremely disheveled and dirty.

Social

Bugbears thrive in rural and wilderness areas, and are rarely found in civilized areas.

They form loose bands of brigands, preying on travelers and remote farmsteads, spreading mayhem quickly and then retreating. They love to torment their victims, and will go out of their way to slowly build up the tension and fear.

Despite this, most bugbears are cowards at heart, and will flee in the face of superior forces unless commanded by a more disciplined hobgoblin officer.

Left on their own, bugbears make their homes deep in the forest or in shallow caves. Bugbear troops are always few in number, as they do not get along well even with each other, although they may be found with a small number of other goblinoids.

Many bugbears prefer solitary lives. Some are so notoriously murderous that they will attack even other bugbears on sight, but others will accept work as mercenaries and channel their killing instinct into gainful employment.

Alignment and Religion

Bugbears are the definition of Chaotic Evil, with most being dedicated to leaving mayhem, murder, violence, and fear in their wake. They readily prefer the worship of demons to all other religious expression.

As with all goblinoids, however, some exceptions do exist. These rare exceptions are most likely to be found in a large, diverse, cosmopolitan town or as part of a small, open-minded adventuring party.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are brutishly strong and fiendishly quick, but your personality is boorish and off-putting. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Dex, –2 Cha [specialized].
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Type You are a Humanoid with the goblinoid subtype.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Goblin. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Draconic, Elven, Giant, Gnoll, and Orc.
Alternate Traits
Senses Darkvision. You have darkvision 60 feet.
Natural Armor You have tough, resilient skin that provides a +1 natural armor bonus.
Scent You have the scent universal monster ability.
Skilled You gain a +2 species bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks.
Stalker Perception and Stealth are always class skills for you.
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with the javelin, morningstar, and scimitar.
